name: kstudio_list_modes
description: List the video modes (kinetic, explainer, promo, data, social) with their theme, music style and tempo, default transition and audit thresholds, plus the output presets, quality levels, frame rates and the time units specs use. Call this first.

name: kstudio_list_scenes
description: List the scene types a spec can use (title, slam, counter, bars, karaoke, ...) with a one-line summary and their parameters with default values. Pass `type` for one scene.

verbose.description: Include parameters and defaults. Default true.

name: kstudio_get_schema
description: Return the JSON Schema of a spec (draft 2020-12). With `mode`, also return that mode's defaults and its example spec, the best starting point for writing a new one.

scene_types.description: Narrow the scene part of the schema to these types. The full schema is large; narrowing keeps it small.

include_example.description: Include the mode's example spec. Default true.

name: kstudio_validate_spec
description: Check a spec without rendering: structure, scene types, parameters, time expressions, transitions, then a dry build and the beat-grid lint. Returns ok, errors and warnings, each with a JSON Pointer path and a hint. Pass spec_path, or spec_json for a spec that is not on disk yet.

spec_path.description: Path of a spec file (spec.json / spec.jsonc / spec.js) or of a project directory that contains one.

spec_json.description: The spec itself as JSON text (comments and trailing commas allowed). Use instead of spec_path.

base_dir.description: Directory relative asset paths in spec_json resolve against. Default: the server's working directory.

strict.description: Treat unknown keys as errors. Default false.

name: kstudio_new_spec
description: Create a project directory from a mode's example (spec.json plus any assets). Pass spec_json to write your own spec instead of the example. Refuses a non-empty directory unless force is true.

spec_json.description: Optional spec as JSON text to write as spec.json.

force.description: Write into a non-empty directory. Default false.

name: kstudio_preview
description: Render still frames (the middle of every scene and every transition, or the times in `at`) and a labelled contact sheet, in a few seconds, without audio. Returns the file paths and the contact sheet as an image. Use it to check layout before a full render.

spec_path.description: Path of a spec file (spec.json / spec.jsonc / spec.js) or of a project directory that contains one.

spec_json.description: The spec itself as JSON text (comments and trailing commas allowed). Use instead of spec_path.

preset.description: Output size: reel/story 1080x1920, landscape/youtube 1920x1080, square 1080x1080, portrait 1080x1350. Default reel.

scale.description: Resolution scale of the stills. Default 0.5.

include_image.description: Attach the contact sheet image. Default true.

name: kstudio_render
description: Render the final MP4 (H.264 High + AAC 48 kHz, -14 LUFS, -1 dBTP) with motion blur, grade, music and sound effects, then audit it. Sends progress notifications when the request has a progressToken. Resumable: an interrupted render keeps finished chunks. ok is true when the video was written and passed the audit; failed_checks lists what did not.

spec_path.description: Path of a spec file (spec.json / spec.jsonc / spec.js) or of a project directory that contains one.

preset.description: Output size: reel/story 1080x1920, landscape/youtube 1920x1080, square 1080x1080, portrait 1080x1350. Default reel.

quality.description: draft (no motion blur, fast), standard (default) or high.

k4.description: Double the preset resolution (4K). Default false.

workers.description: Render processes. Default: sized to free memory and CPUs.

fresh.description: Ignore finished chunks from an earlier run. Default false.

audit.description: Run the quality audit. Default true.

snap.description: Snap seconds-valued scene lengths and starts to this beat division.

name: kstudio_audit
description: Measure a finished video: motion ratio and longest hold, black frames, codec and pixel format, loudness and true peak, frame rate (r = avg = n/d), frame count and audio/video length. ok is true when every check passes.

mode.description: Use this mode's motion and hold thresholds.

max_hold.description: Longest allowed still hold in seconds.
